name: EXM_CATEGORY_FIELDS
description: This table contains the data elements that needs to be captured for an expense category for a business unit, such as ticket number and ticket class for the expense category of Airfare and their display properties in an expense report.

columns.name: CATEGORY_FIELD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the set of fields applicable for an expense category and a business unit.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: A unique identifier of a classification of expense types, such as accommodations or airfare.

columns.name: END_DATE_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Checkout Date for the expense category of Accommodations.

columns.name: MERCHANT_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Merchant Name for all expense categories.

columns.name: TICKET_CLASS_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Flight Class for the expense category of Airfare.

columns.name: TICKET_NUMBER_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Ticket Number for the expense category of Airfare.

columns.name: TICKET_TYPE_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Flight Type for the expense category of Airfare.

columns.name: LOCATION_FROM_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of departure location for the expense category of Airfare, Car Rental and Mileage.

columns.name: LOCATION_TO_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of arrival location for the expense category of Airfare, Car Rental and Mileage.

columns.name: LICENSE_PLATE_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of License Plate for the expense category of Mileage.

columns.name: STARTING_ODOMETER_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Starting Odometer Reading for the expense category of Mileage.

columns.name: ENDING_ODOMETER_FIELD
columns.description: Display behavior of Ending Odometer Reading for the expense category of Mileage.

columns.name: AGENCY_FIELD
columns.description: Determine whether Agency Name will be optional, required, or hidden during expense entry.

columns.name: PASSENGER_NAME_FIELD
columns.description: Determine whether Passenger Name will be optional, required, or hidden during expense entry.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
